modern: Whatever may happen to you, it was prepared for you from all eternity; and the interweaving of causes was from eternity spinning the thread of your being, and of what happens to it.
original: Whatever may happen to thee, it was prepared for thee from all eternity; and the implication of causes was from eternity spinning the thread of thy being, and of that which is incident to it.
